annotations.title: Insider purchases and sales by quarter

description: Returns what executives, directors and 10% owners of the tracked AI and semiconductor companies bought and sold on SEC Form 4 in one quarter: totals and how many people and companies, the largest sellers and buyers (role, company, trades, shares still held, filing), the companies most sold and bought by their insiders, totals by role and by month, and new insiders (first Form 3). Default: the last closed quarter (a Form 4 is due two business days after the trade); `quarter: 'current'` for the quarter in progress; quarters from Q3 2024. Use it when the user asks what insiders bought or sold. Only purchases and sales count — `method` and `caveats` in the answer say what is and is not counted. For one company's insiders, use get_ownership; for one person, pass the returned `holder` to get_holders.

quarter.description: 'latest' (default: the last closed quarter), 'current' (the quarter in progress, to date) or a quarter such as 'q3-2026' (from 'q3-2024').
